acceptance_rule.acceptance: every required independent verifier returns PASS on the exact candidate bytes
acceptance_rule.failure: one counterexample is sufficient to reject a candidate
acceptance_rule.output_requirement: nondecreasing on channels 0..12 for every input

required_baseline_checks: accept exact 45-comparator baseline on all 8192 binary inputs
reject every one of the 45 single-comparator deletion mutants
reject input-dependent or variable-length candidate encodings

candidate_constraints: same fixed ordered comparator sequence for every input
candidate_semantics.candidate_representation: ordered JSON array of comparator pairs

comparator.operation: replace positions i,j by min(value_i,value_j), max(value_i,value_j)

dispositions.AUTHORITY_REVISION_REQUIRED: The frozen problem definition or acceptance authority is contradictory or insufficient and must be superseded.
dispositions.METHOD_NEEDS_REPAIR: The authority remains coherent but verifier, search, evidence, or review machinery has repairable defects.
dispositions.METHOD_NOT_VIABLE: The planned search/verification approach cannot be made trustworthy within declared constraints.
dispositions.SEARCH_EXHAUSTED_WITHOUT_RESOLUTION: Authorized search budget ended without a standing witness. No lower-bound or nonexistence claim is permitted.
dispositions.WITNESS_FOUND_AND_VERIFIED: A <=44 comparator candidate passed every frozen independent verifier and required review. This establishes an improved upper bound only.

frontier_snapshot.research_claim: A valid <=44-comparator witness would improve the public best-known upper bound regardless of the lower-bound dispute.

sources.name: Bert Dobbelaere - List of sorting networks / SorterHunter
Codish et al. - Optimal-depth sorting networks
sources.role: background on SAT/formal verification and sorting-network optimality

prohibitions: Do not claim that 45 comparators are necessary.
Do not treat the contested/listed 44 lower bound as proved authority.
Do not infer nonexistence from search failure.
Do not let a searcher, candidate generator, or LLM certify its own candidate.
Do not change the acceptance predicate after inspecting a promising candidate.
Do not delete failed candidates, failed qualifications, or rejected reviews.
title: Construct a 13-channel sorting network with at most 44 comparators

verification_requirements.review_requirement: fresh hostile review bound to verifier source and qualification evidence before search output may receive standing
verification_requirements.verifier_b: separately implemented verifier with independent derivation and no code reuse from verifier_a
